## Context

Implement the accepted scope from architecture recommendations 2, 4, and 6, following the evidence on `expecting-renowned-buzzard`.

Current `origin/main` still has three related sources of protocol complexity:

- Reconciler `Mutation` has typed direction/action but a generic `Mapping[str, Any]` payload. Outbound typed mutations are converted through `_mutation_to_batch_dict()` into the legacy batch shape; two CREATE shapes and a polymorphic `applier.apply()` remain.
- `PydanticAIRunner.run()` has regrown after ADR 0056. Existing ownership seams already include `ProviderSession`, `model_classes`, `structured_run`, `agent_call`, `runner_support`, capability modules, and ordered success/failure telemetry. The next change must improve those boundaries, not duplicate them.
- ADR 0098's `OperationSnapshot` is authoritative for reconciler runtime bindings, but CLI/shared command paths still call `emit_shadow_snapshot()`, and many LLM operations independently resolve `LLMConfig.from_env()`.

This epic completes these migrations. It extends ADR 0103 rather than reopening its retry/coordinator decision, works within ADRs 0056 and 0058 unless the runner research child proves an amendment is needed, and completes ADR 0098's expand/contract migration.

## Outcomes

### A. One typed reconciler representation and one production route

Define payload types as a discriminated union by `(direction, action)`, carry them through planner/coordinator/adapter boundaries, prove behavior against a broad corpus in side-effect-free shadow mode, then cut production over and delete dictionary translation and legacy dispatch in this epic. Deletion is part of the cutover, not a follow-up.

### A1. Reconciler runway and producer inputs

Restore <=700-line headroom in the uncovered spine modules, then eliminate the loose 24-value
producer seam using Brant/RP-03 types and owners—never a second generic context.

### B. Runner lifecycle ownership grounded in current architecture

First produce a current effect/resource timeline and fault matrix. Then reshape only call-graph seams that the evidence supports, preserving `ProviderSession` as provider-resource owner, fallback `ExitStack` ordering, failure accounting, pre-finalization success logging, final spend/result-shape updates, provider provenance, and existing injection contracts.

No new function-NLOC ratchet or per-file headroom gate is in scope. ADR 0058's single 800-LOC ceiling remains the hard gate and debt signal. The reconciler's one-time prerequisite extractions restore room under that existing gate; they do not create another enforcement mechanism. Any future function-size metric requires separate evidence and approval.

### C. Authoritative operation configuration

Make the existing `OperationSnapshot` and focused runtime bindings behavior-bearing at the CLI, MCP, Python, shared command/store, and LLM operation boundaries. An operation composes once; downstream code consumes projections/context and cannot reread environment, files, or CWD. Remove diagnostic shadow composition and migrated ambient-resolution paths after parity.

## Verification strategy (executed; see AC evidence below for outcomes)

Portable/default-CI shadow replay; ephemeral Jira DC exact-patchset differential/convergence; runner fault-injection across lifecycle boundaries; consumer-level metamorphic config tests. The Jira DC lane is additive evidence, not the only gate.

## Constraints

- No production dual-write/double-send comparison.
- Reuse the existing ephemeral Jira DC harness and isolation assertions; do not build a second DC test environment.
- Preserve Jira Cloud behavior with verified fakes/transport contracts even though large-scale live mutation testing uses disposable DC.
- Reuse `OperationSnapshot`, central schema/provenance, `LLMRuntime`, `ProviderSession`, and current runner leaf modules; no second config schema, generic hook bus, plugin framework, or decorative frozen lifecycle carriers.
- Reuse reconciler `Observation`, `TicketPlan`, and current pass/runtime owners; no generic option-bag replacement.
- String imports, monkeypatch targets, and compatibility re-exports require a census before movement/deletion.
- New structural decisions complete the ADR lifecycle before dependent implementation; accepted ADRs are constraints, not prose to reimplement.
- Keep every intermediate Gerrit change independently testable and green.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Every supported reconciler `(direction, action)` has one typed payload contract; planners/coordinator/adapters/tests consume it without generic dicts. Evidence: f448 (spec) -> e9d5 (typed payloads+corpus) -> 6452 (converged inputs) -> 3f27 (cutover). `outbound_pass.py` builds every Mutation with a typed `Outbound{Create,Update,Delete}Payload`.
- [x] Portable shadow corpus covers create/update/delete/probe/conflict, inbound-only, links/comments/labels/status/parent/binding, retries, malformed input, suppression, multi-project routing; traces match. Evidence: `test_payload_shadow_corpus.py`+`test_payload_shadow_effect_spies.py` (36 tests, green post-cutover).
- [x] Exact-patchset ephemeral Jira DC CI run proves isolated differential parity and typed-only post-deletion convergence, no live-remote route. Evidence: `jira-dc-exact-patchset.yml` (3f27), live-run 33455991406: 74 passed, 1 skipped (LLM-gated), 1 xfailed (pre-existing, 2b16), 0 failed. Verified SHA matched pushed revision.
- [x] Duplicate CREATE-shape ambiguity deleted; one production route remains (3f27). `_mutation_to_batch_dict`/the `MutationShape` ternary are RETAINED-justified: both serve `apply()`'s separate, still-documented `list[dict]` legacy-batch calling convention (deleting broke ~50 unrelated tests) -- not dead legacy. Full census on 3f27 / `docs/architecture.md`.
- [x] Runner research records ownership/effect timeline + ADR disposition before refactoring; reuses established seams, no new size gate. Evidence: c465 (research: ADR 0056 already authorizes the seam, no restructuring warranted) -> 6586 (no code moved, owner map confirmed, suites green unchanged).
- [x] CLI/MCP/Python/shared command-store/LLM operations compose one authoritative snapshot/context; consumers don't reread ambient config. Evidence: 3a08 (CLI/command/store) + ec44 (LLM ops; `LLMRuntime`/`ProviderSession` remain resource owners).
- [x] Diagnostic shadow composition + migrated legacy resolution paths deleted; ownership checks/metamorphic tests prevent reintroduction. Evidence: 3a08 deleted 23 `_shadow(...)`/CLI call sites; ec44 deleted `emit_shadow_snapshot`+switch+migrated `from_env` branches. `check_config_ownership.py` carries zero new exceptions.
- [x] Focused suites, default suite, lint, typecheck, complexity/module-size gates, portable oracles, Jira DC lane pass; docs/ADR status match landed architecture. Evidence: `make test` 18,568 passed (8 pre-existing/host-only, reconfirmed unrelated), lint/typecheck clean, DC lane green (run 33455991406). ADR 0107 + ADR 0098 both landed.
- [x] `reconcile.py`/`reconcile_helpers.py` each <=700 LOC via cohesive deletion/extraction; lifecycle facade + ADR 0099 boundary guarded. Current: 333/394 LOC (0f21/7153 headroom + e9d5/3f27 cutover deletions).
- [x] No producer retains/repackages the 24-value outbound-update bundle; cohesive Brant/RP-03 inputs. Evidence: 6452 reduced `_compute_outbound_update_mutation` 24->10, `_compute_outbound_create_mutation` 11->7 params per ADR 0107 (rejected generic-context wrapper).
- [x] Final epic evidence reports deleted representations/routes/ambient authorities; no cleanup deferred solely to keep both paths live. Deleted: dict-payload route, CREATE-shape ambiguity, 23 shadow call sites, `emit_shadow_snapshot`+switch, migrated `from_env` branches, 24-value bundle. Retained-justified items serve an unrelated, still-documented calling convention. Full sweep in the epic comment thread.
